title: Agents
heading: Build your working team
intro: Give agents a role, connect the right context, and review their work in one place.
failed: This action could not be completed.
instructionsHint: Describe the outcome, constraints, and evidence this agent should produce…
budgetHint: Budgets use UTC calendar months. Queued and running work reserves its cost limit. External workers report actual costs; this is a workspace limit, not a provider billing cap.
emptyTeam: Add your first agent, then grant access to a project and assign a task.
teamHint: Assign roles and project access, connect a worker, and choose review or automatic completion for each task.
adapterHint: The local planner turns a brief and linked pages into a checklist. Connect an external worker for AI execution; its credential only opens its own assigned runs.
workerHint: Issue a seven-day credential for this external agent. Use the documented runtime API to poll, claim, heartbeat and submit work. Revoking access invalidates active leases.
tokenOnce: This credential is shown once. Copy it to your worker’s private configuration.
accessHint: Grant access before assigning an agent. Observers cannot run tasks. Revoking contributor access cancels the agent’s active runs in this project.
briefHint: What needs to happen, and how will you verify it?
noDependencies: Other tasks in this project can become dependencies.
contextHint: Only these linked pages are included with the task. Agents receive a bounded snapshot when you dispatch it.
noPages: Create docs, notes or database records to connect context.
assignmentChanged: This assignment changed elsewhere. Reload the latest version before saving.
plannerHint: The built-in planner prepares a checklist from this brief. It does not call an AI model or carry out the checklist.
externalHint: Dispatch to the connected worker. Set a cost limit that fits the agent’s available monthly budget.
commentHint: Add context, a decision, or a question…
emptyWork: Create a project task here, or use tasks already on your Projects board.
externalWaiting: Waiting for an external worker to claim this run. Connect a worker using this agent’s credential.
reviewHint: Review the result and evidence. Approval completes the original Projects task. Rejection leaves it blocked for another attempt.
noRuns: Dispatch an assigned task to start a run.

automation.title: Task automation
automation.dispatch: Dispatch automatically when dependencies are complete
automation.approve: Complete the task automatically after a successful result
automation.hint: Save these choices with the assignment. A connected worker queues eligible ready tasks within budget. Automatic completion applies to this task; failures stay blocked for review and retry.

metering.cachedHint: {{cached}} cached tokens are included in input, not added to the total.
metering.meteredHint: Runs with reported token counts. Unreported usage remains unknown.
metering.pageTrendHint: Runs on this history page, ordered by creation time. Gaps represent unreported usage.
metering.hint: Reported token usage and costs from configured worker rates. Cached tokens are part of input tokens. Unknown counts stay unknown; these records are not provider invoices. The month filter uses the run creation date.
metering.coverage: {{known}} of {{total}} runs have token counts · {{cached}} cached input tokens
metering.overrun: Worker reported {{cost}}; reconcile the cost above the reservation.
metering.empty: No usage records match these filters.

runUnavailable: This run is unavailable. Refresh the workspace or choose another run.

playbooks.intro: Reusable instructions and completion policies for your agents, inspired by ECC.
playbooks.assignmentHint: Select up to eight playbooks in agent settings. Their instructions and checks are captured when a task is dispatched. Playbooks belong to your account and can be reused across enabled workspaces.
playbooks.emptyAssignment: Create a playbook in Playbooks & skills, then assign it here.
playbooks.empty: Create reusable working instructions or start with a template.
playbooks.requireReview: Require human review even when the task allows automatic completion
playbooks.checksHint: Up to 10 unique checks, each at most 240 characters. Workers must report a passing result and concrete evidence for every check before completion. Leave empty for instructions only.
playbooks.snapshotHint: Changes apply to future dispatches. Existing runs retain their original instructions, checks and revision. Archiving excludes the playbook from new runs.
playbooks.startersHint: Original monolith templates based on ECC’s research-first and verification-loop concepts. Review and save before assigning.
playbooks.evidenceHint: Evidence is reported by the worker and remains subject to human review. monolith validates required entries; it does not execute these checks or independently verify their claims.
playbooks.plannerHint: The local planner cannot execute quality checks. Choose a connected runtime or an instructions-only playbook.

research.name: Research before implementation
research.description: Source-backed investigation with explicit constraints and review.
research.instructions: Clarify the required outcome and inspect existing behavior before making changes. Research primary documentation and reusable approaches. Record sources, relevant versions, alternatives and uncertainties. Recommend an approach that fits the project’s conventions, access boundaries and budget. Present evidence with the result and request review before consequential changes.
research.checks:
Identify primary sources and applicable versions
Compare the proposed approach against the existing system
Record unresolved assumptions and constraints

verification.name: Verify before completion
verification.description: A repeatable verification loop with evidence for reviewers.
verification.instructions: Define acceptance criteria before starting. Complete the scoped task, then run the project’s appropriate build, types, lint and meaningful tests. Inspect the changed behavior and review the final diff for unintended changes, secrets and unhandled failures. Report exact commands, outcomes and limitations. Never mark unperformed checks as passed; stop and report blockers.
verification.checks:
Verify applicable build, type and lint checks
Exercise the changed behavior with meaningful tests
Review the final diff and report remaining limitations
